name: Pass the Hash

evidence.rationale: Using role-based access control (RBAC) to prevent domain users from being local administrators on multiple systems can help limit adversaries’ ability to reuse NTLM hashes for lateral movement.
ATT&CK identifies Windows 7 and higher system patch KB2871997 as limiting default access available to local administrator accounts, reducing some pass-the-hash lateral movement.

Applying relevant Windows security updates can restrict default remote access available to local administrator accounts and reduce some pass-the-hash activity. Remediation does not eliminate hash theft, NTLM use, or pass-the-hash through accounts that retain applicable privileges.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
